    "Model forecasts are too slow to react to sentiment changes, showing lag instead of immediate price shifts",

    "Model mean reversion level is approximately 3-4 points below current prices when sentiment is strong",
    "Large forecast-true price divergences (10+ points) occur when sentiment has been uniformly positive for 5+ days",
    "Model fails to capture momentum peaks, always forecasting below true maximums",
    "When price is consolidating, model over-smooths and lags behind true price fluctuations"
